caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object with a U-shaped structure, resembling an inverted horseshoe. The object has a rough, textured surface and is primarily brown with some darker brown and grayish sections on the ends. There are two circular holes, one on each side of the vertical legs of the object, positioned symmetrically near the middle of each leg. The legs of the object curve outward and widen as they reach the ends, which are flat and slightly angled. The top part of the object is thicker and somewhat flat, giving it a more solid appearance at the arch. The background is a light cream color, and the drawing is centered on the page. The name "Samuel Faign" is printed underneath the object in small letters.
title: Skid Shoe for Horse
